comment: Region tileset (roadmap F6b): only in this test, Hyrule Castle takes the CastleTop region tileset (RegionTiles: ts_CastleTop, cut from the ALttP overworld by tools/alttp/owdump.py tiles and imported from incoming/topo-do-castelo/tiles). The paint step lays 12x10 blocks in the start room, the front of the castle as in area 0x1B (map16 x 26-37, y 8-17), and reads the classes back: the log line must say blocks=120 of 120 classes=floor,solid,grave,dig. The second paint is its top left block mirrored. The castle itself is built as always.
name: region_tiles
